item.title: 383-Powered 1963 Chevrolet Impala SS Sport Coupe 4-Speed
item.description: This 1963 Chevrolet Impala SS sport coupe underwent a refurbishment under prior ownership before it was acquired by seller on BaT in January 2024. Work during the refurbishment included a repaint in yellow with a white roof, an interior retrim, and installation of a four-corner air suspension system as well as a 383ci stroker V8 linked with a Muncie four-speed manual transmission. item.title: 2024 Lotus Emira GT4
item.description: This 2024 Lotus Emira is a track-only variant built by RML Group in Northamptonshire, England, for homologation in international GT4 racing classes. The car was purchased in 2024 by its current owner and was used for participation in events at the Thermal Club in Riverside, California. Power is provided by a Lotus-tuned 3.5-liter Toyota V6 that features a Harrop supercharger, dry-sump lubrication, and MoTeC engine management. item.title: 2022 Mercedes-AMG AMG GT Track Series
item.description: This 2022 Mercedes-AMG GT Track Series is #30 of 55 track-only examples produced for the model year to commemorate the founding of Mercedes-AMG in 1967. item.title: Original-Owner 1979 BMW M1
item.description: This 1979 BMW M1 is one of a claimed 399 road-going examples built over two and a half years of production. Chassis 1101 is said to have been ordered new by the current owner in January 1979 and picked up in Germany before being air-freighted to the US and federalized by California-based Dietel Enterprises in 1981. item.title: 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera RS Clubsport
item.description: This 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera RS is one of a reported 227 examples optioned with the track-focused M003 Clubsport package, which was designed in an effort to homologate the car for the BPR GT3 and GT4 categories. Delivered new to Austria, the car was specified in Riviera Blue with air conditioning. item.title: This Week’s Weird and Wonderful—February 20, 2026
item.description: Hopefully you've all survived St. Valentine's Day with your hearts intact, but if things didn't go as planned, let this week's Weird and Wonderful be a balm for your emotional wounds. Here we have assembled a collection of interesting, impressive, strange, and noteworthy vehicles from out of the ~800 or so on our live auctions page, in hopes that you may feel joy once again by pondering these treasures of transportation. And if that doesn't help, well...there are burnouts.

item.title: 2011 Ferrari 599 GTO at No Reserve
item.description: This 2011 Ferrari 599 GTO is one of approximately 125 designated for the US market from a 599-unit global production run. Chassis 177253 was sold new at Ferrari of Silicon Valley in Redwood City, California, in 2013 and later exported to Canada before being acquired by the selling dealer and relocated back to the US.
